newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguayan GDP rises 4.9 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Uruguayan GDP rises 4.9 pct in 1996.

text.p: Uruguay's gross domestic product rose 4.90 percent in 1996 after falling 2.43 percent in 1995, the Statistics Institute said Wednesday.
Farm sector activity grew 8.4 percent last year. Transport and communications rose 6.0 percent, industry 4.5 percent, and gas, electricity and water services 3.1 percent.
Business, restaurants and hotels climbed 2.9 percent, and construction 1.1 percent.
"At the beginning of 1996 we expected a 1.0 percent growth, and this increase is five times bigger," the head of the Statistics Institute, Ariel Davrieux, told reporters.
Davrieux said increased exports were partly responsible for the rise in 1996.
The government expects 3.0 percent GDP growth this year.
